Code 57/5/3, BIOLOGY (Theory), 3 hours, 70 marks, 23 printed pages, 33 questions); idx 1 is the Hindi instructions; every ODD index 3-21 is the Hindi facing page. Checked on the contact sheet and by a word scan of the text layer of every odd page: the only Latin tokens on any odd page are roman numerals, 'Pst' (idx 7), 'hnRNA' (idx 15) and 'pBR'/'rop' (idx 17), all inside Hindi blocks, so no English overflows onto an odd page and the parity never inverts. Each English page ends on a whole question, so no question is split across pages. The paper is born-digital: the text layer was used as a DRAFT only and every row was checked against the full-size page. Instruction (viii) names Sections B, D and E and gives no count; the roster was built from the marking scheme's bare ORs and confirmed against a printed OR on the page: Q18, Q19, Q21, Q29(b), Q30(b), Q31, Q32, Q33, eight alternatives, none in Section C and none on Q17 or Q20. Primary marks: A16 + B10 + C21 + D8 + E15 = 70. Marking scheme used: 'XII_044_MS_57_5_3.pdf' (the only version for this set; no revised copy exists in the folder). Section-A key read off the scheme IMAGE (ms idx 2) and independently from the scheme's text layer: BCDCDBDBCDCCBCAB, 16 of 16 agree. The scheme carries no award-regardless note anywhere (scanned all eleven pages).
